To apply for aNational Visa, you need two health insurances: Incoming health insuranceThis isexpat health insurance. It covers you from the day you arrive in Germany until you start working or studying. There aremany valid options. I recommendFeather, but there aremany other options. andlong-term health insuranceWhen you start working or studying, you must usually switch topublicorprivatehealth insurance. For public health insurance, chooseBarmerorTK. For private health insurance, alwaysask an expert. How to choose health insurance In theConsular Services Portal, you must upload a proof of incoming health insuranceanda proof of long-term health insurance.Merge them together, and upload them underProof of health insurance. Your incoming health insurance must cover you from the day you plan to arrive in Germany. It must match the dates you entered in theTravel dataform in theConsular Services Portal.
